source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
When an **ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC** or **ASTRA MILITARUM SQUADRON** unit of yours is picked to shoot, its models may target an enemy unit within the shooting unit's **Engagement Range**, even with Blast weapons, as long as no other friendly unit is within that enemy unit's Engagement Range.

When they do, they ignore the **Hit roll** penalty for shooting while within Engagement Range of enemy units, except for attacks with Indirect Fire weapons.
